caption: Golden Fortune Import & Export Corp. v. Mei-Xin Ltd.
citation_line: Golden Fortune Import & Export Corp. v. Mei-Xin Ltd., No. 2:22-cv-01369; rev'd, Nos. 22-1710 & 22-1885 (3d Cir. Aug. 5, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Neals preliminarily enjoined termination of a long-running mooncake distribution agreement, found the dispute arbitrable, and directed an interim security arrangement pending arbitration.
qualification_rationale: The case tested the New Jersey Franchise Practices Act's community-of-interest and gross-sales requirements and the proof needed to convert business loss into irreparable harm.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit reversed in a nonprecedential opinion, finding neither likely NJFPA coverage nor irreparable harm. The nonprecedential status limits the score.
